title: Government e-Marketplace General Terms & Conditions (GTC) v4.0
authority: GeM Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Mandatory contractual conditions and qualification criteria for all sellers, service providers, and buyers transacting on the GeM portal.

clauses.title: Mandatory GST Compliance & Regular Return Filing
clauses.legal_text: All sellers registered on GeM must maintain an Active GSTIN status and demonstrate regular filing of GSTR-3B and GSTR-1 returns. Sellers with irregular tax filing status or suspended registrations shall be disqualified from technical evaluation.

conditions.failure_message: Violation of GeM GTC Clause 4.1: GSTIN status is not Active (Suspended or Cancelled).
Violation of GeM GTC Clause 4.1: GST return filing regularity is below 75% threshold in the last 12 months.

clauses.title: OEM Authorization & MAF Specificity Mandate
clauses.legal_text: In bids requiring Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) authorization, the reseller/bidder must upload an unexpired Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) explicitly naming the Buyer Organization, Tender Reference Number, and GeM Bid Number.

conditions.failure_message: Violation of GeM GTC Clause 4.8: OEM Manufacturer Authorization Form is missing, expired, or references an invalid tender/bid number.

clauses.title: Income Tax Section 206AB Compliance
clauses.legal_text: Bidders must not be non-filers of income tax returns as defined under Section 206AB of the Income Tax Act, 1961. Verified PAN records must be linked with Aadhaar and in operative standing.

conditions.failure_message: Violation of GeM GTC Clause 4.14: Specified as non-filer under Section 206AB of Income Tax Act.
